title: Skill Definition
description: JSON Schema describing a skill definition with its metadata gotchas and tools

$schema.description: Optional relative path to this schema so editors can validate the file

name.description: Skill name made of two short common nouns with no verbs

description.description: One short sentence saying when to use the skill not just what it does

gotchas.description: List of DIW notes in which no item is a near duplicate of another

tools.description: List of tools the skill provides

diw.description: A single DIW item with a dont an instead and a why

instead.description: The good action to take which must be concrete not vague

why.description: Explains why the good action matters without restating it

name.description: Tool name is a single lowercase verb

use_when.description: One short sentence saying when to use the tool not just what it does

language.description: Language the tool script is written in

description.description: One short sentence with no trailing period

spec.description: Implementation spec whose lines are complete enough to write the tool from

examples.description: One or more example command lines for running the tool

jsonSchemaObject.description: A nested JSON Schema describing an object used for tool input and output

propertySchema.description: Describes a single property inside an input or output schema

items.description: Element schema required when type is array

description.description: One short sentence with no trailing period
